public_payload.normalized_proposition: Basically every AI data center Zitron has seen uses environmentally disastrous behind-the-meter gas turbines.

statement.excerpt: None of this matters, because basically every AI data center I’ve seen uses behind-the-meter gas turbines that are an environmental disaster.

from_speaker: basically every AI data center I’ve seen
our_interpretation: The relevant population is the AI data centers Zitron had encountered, not all data centers worldwide. Publicly discussed sites could help reconstruct that population.

The plain reading is that nearly all those sites actually use on-site gas turbines and cause serious environmental harm. Announced plants, reciprocating engines and grid-supplied gas generation are not interchangeable with operating behind-the-meter turbines.
For this ongoing observation, use August 2026, the latest complete month before publication. This period is an evaluator choice because the post names none.
criteria.support_condition: A sufficiently complete inventory of the sites he meant shows operating behind-the-meter gas turbines at nearly all of them, with credible evidence of serious environmental harm.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Evidence covering that same population shows a substantial share without operating behind-the-meter gas turbines, or shows that the claimed serious environmental effects do not hold across nearly all sites.
